# AppShell

Page layout for apps: fixed sidebar (brand, Nav, footer), 56px header, scrolling main area.

`KenosUI.AppShell` · Layout

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.AppShell>…</KenosUI.AppShell>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.AppShell">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

App layout: sidebar + header + scrolling main. Under 768px the sidebar becomes a drawer.

## Props (AppShellProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brand` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `sidebar` | `React.ReactNode` | Usually <Nav/>. |
| `sidebarFooter` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `header` | `React.ReactNode` | Top bar content (Breadcrumb, search, user Menu). |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
